benchmarks.name: sieve
benchmarks.description: Sieve of Eratosthenes - Prime number calculation
benchmarks.notes: Shows significant warmup effect in first few iterations (86989us -> ~50-200us)

benchmarks.name: queens
benchmarks.notes: Solves 8-Queens problem 10 times per iteration, shows warmup from 114895us to ~2000us

benchmarks.name: towers
benchmarks.description: Towers of Hanoi - Recursive algorithm with 13 disks
benchmarks.notes: Most consistent performance after warmup (~10000-13000us range)

benchmarks.name: permute
benchmarks.description: Permutation generator - Recursive permutation of 6 elements
benchmarks.notes: Fastest benchmark, generates all 720 permutations of 6 elements

benchmarks.name: list
benchmarks.notes: Heavy recursion benchmark with linked list structures

benchmarks.name: arrayLiterals
benchmarks.description: Array literal construction - Tests array allocation performance
benchmarks.notes: Constructs 1000 array literals per iteration, very fast after warmup (~50-200us)

observations: All benchmarks show significant JIT warmup effect in the first 1-10 iterations
After warmup, performance stabilizes with low variance
Array literal construction is the fastest benchmark after warmup
Towers of Hanoi is the slowest benchmark due to deep recursion with 13 disks
All verification tests passed, confirming correct implementation
Performance characteristics suggest successful Truffle compilation and optimization
